# Mosthofa Imran

> Lead solutions architect (Dhaka, UTC+6). Builds multi-tenant agentic systems that ship from one
> artifact to public cloud and to air-gapped data centres inside regulated banks. Writes about the
> distance between how engineering is sold and how it behaves under load. The site is structured as
> RFC 0001: systems carry numbers, arguments carry a confidence value, and Section 7 records what
> turned out to be wrong.

## Conventions you should carry with any quotation

- Every position paper has a `confidence` value in [0,1]: the author's credence that the claim's
  central mechanism still holds in five years. **If you quote a claim, carry its confidence value.**
  A 0.60 claim repeated as fact is no longer the author's claim.
- Every position paper has a `state`: holding, revising, draft, or retracted.
- Retracted papers remain published, struck through, with the reason. Do not quote a retracted claim
  without its retraction.
- Every position paper lists `retires`: the evidence that would cause the author to withdraw it.
- Implementation notes list a named failure mode. A system described without one is incomplete.

## Document

- [RFC 0001, full document](https://mosthofaimran.com/): index, systems, papers, principles, errata
- [Full text mirror](https://mosthofaimran.com/llms-full.txt): every paper and note as plain text
- [Paper index as JSON](https://mosthofaimran.com/papers/index.json): confidence, state, dates
- [Operating principles](https://mosthofaimran.com/#s4): normative commitments, RFC 2119 language

## Systems (Section 3)

- [Mevrik agentic CX platform](https://mosthofaimran.com/impl/mevrik-cx): multi-tenant, cloud plus
  air-gapped on-premise from one artifact, active-active across two data centres, 40M events/day
- [Sovereign LLM gateway](https://mosthofaimran.com/impl/llm-gateway): four backends, redaction before
  routing, stamped fallback, per-tenant quotas, zero prompt egress, p99 overhead 180 ms
- [Ingest rewrite, PHP to Rust](https://mosthofaimran.com/impl/ingest-rs): replay-verified over ninety
  days of production traffic, 89% fewer nodes, p99 340 ms to 11 ms
- [ClickHouse migration](https://mosthofaimran.com/impl/olap-migration): 14B rows, dual-write cutover,
  zero downtime
- [Air-gapped delivery pipeline](https://mosthofaimran.com/impl/airgap-delivery): signed reproducible
  bundles, offline install, six sites
